scoring.rule: Capability readiness is separate from research fit. Scores are the sum of five proof stages: design/spec 10, implementation 30, automated proof 20, runtime proof 20, operator acceptance 20. A stage contributes only when canonical evidence explicitly supports it. 100 means every stage is proven; research strength alone never raises capability readiness.
